correctness.rationale: The source recurrence with two independent real N(0,1) increments reduces exactly to |Z2|²/v=G1²+G2²+2G1G2 cos(θ+βG1²). Conditioning on G2 shows zero cross covariance and gives normalized variance 4+4 E[G1²cos²(θ+βG1²)]. The standard differentiated Gaussian transform E[G²e^(itG²)]=(1-2it)^(-3/2) gives the closed cosine, modulus, and equality phases for all real θ and β>=0. For zero θ, t=atan(4β) and F(t)=cos^(3/2)t cos(3t/2) has derivative -(3/2)cos^(1/2)t sin(5t/2), with unique minimum at t=2π/5. Complex isotropic kicks with equal mean squared amplitude have variance 4v² from law of total variance, a distinctly different noise covariance, so no false model equivalence. Independent Gaussian quadrature checked four β and three θ values; the universal formula is an algebraic identity independent of finite numerical diagnostics.
residual_risks: Exactly two steps, scalar cubic phase, real iid rank-one Gaussian kicks and fixed positive h,σ, nonnegative κ; the isotropic case deliberately changes noise covariance. Not a PDE or long-time convergence result.

final_claim: For the exact scalar cubic stochastic Schrödinger Lie–Trotter recurrence with real rank-one additive Gaussian kicks, Z0=0, v=σ²h>0, θ=ωh and β=κhv>=0, E|Z2|²=2v and Var(|Z2|²)/v²=6+2(1+16β²)^(-3/4)cos(2θ+(3/2)atan(4β)). The sharp phase extrema are 6±2(1+16β²)^(-3/4); for β>0 the real-kick minimum exceeds the isotropic complex-kick variance 4. At θ=0 the unique nonlinear minimum occurs at β=tan(2π/5)/4.
limitations: Exactly two steps, scalar cubic phase, real iid rank-one Gaussian kicks and fixed positive h,σ, nonnegative κ; the isotropic case deliberately changes noise covariance. Not a PDE or long-time convergence result.
